Hartcliffe and Withywood — Bristol, United Kingdom

🟢 Official crime data · Avon and Somerset Constabulary, data.police.uk Methodology →

Relatively safer day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Avon and Somerset Constabulary recorded 842 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — an average of 14.7 per 1,000 residents a month, the 9th highest rate of Bristol's 34 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (17), vehicle crime (10), burglary (7); the evening/night score by violent crime (126), anti social behaviour (38), public order (20). Those two scores are split by offence type, not by clock time — the police feed records no time of day, so day and night here mean the kinds of crime typical of each, not counts of incidents observed then. Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Hartcliffe and Withywood safe?

Wandroz currently rates Hartcliffe and Withywood in Bristol as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bristol during the day and an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Bristol at night. This rating is derived from Avon and Somerset Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Hartcliffe and Withywood safe at night?

At night, Hartcliffe and Withywood is rated as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Bristol. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Hartcliffe and Withywood a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Hartcliffe and Withywood's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bristol) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
